## Summary

Allow choosing a member's profile picture from an image that already exists in the gallery, instead of only uploading a new file.

## Motivation

Today the profile picture is set exclusively by uploading a file and cropping it (`EditMode` → `ImageCropDialog`). But members often already have gallery photos linked to them (shown in `MemberPhotos`). Re-uploading the same photo just to use it as an avatar is wasteful and duplicates media.

## Proposed approach

- In `MemberPhotos` (and/or the gallery `ImageSheet`), add a "Set as profile picture" action on a linked gallery image.
- Feed that image into the existing `ImageCropDialog` so the user can crop it to an avatar, then write the result to the member's `imageData` (same path the current upload flow uses).
- Decide whether the avatar references the gallery file or stores its own cropped copy (a cropped copy is simplest and matches current behaviour; note media-quota implications either way).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] From a member's linked gallery photos, the user can pick one and set it as the profile picture (with crop)
- [ ] Resulting avatar shows on the node/sheet like any uploaded avatar
- [ ] Respects existing image size/quota validation
- [ ] i18n keys in all locales
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `## [Unreleased]`

## Relevant Files

- `frontend/src/components/shared/member-sheet/MemberPhotos.tsx`
- `frontend/src/components/shared/member-sheet/dialog/ImageCropDialog.tsx`
- `frontend/src/components/shared/member-sheet/EditMode.tsx` (imageData handling)
- `frontend/src/components/view/gallery-view/ImageSheet.tsx`

# Plan: Set a member's profile picture from an existing gallery image (#776)

## Context

Today a member's profile picture can only be set by **uploading a new file** and
cropping it (`EditMode` → `ImageCropDialog`). But members usually already have
gallery photos linked to them (shown in `MemberPhotos` on the Records tab).
Re-uploading the same photo just to use it as an avatar wastes media quota and
duplicates files. Issue #776 asks to let the user pick an already-linked gallery
image and crop it into the avatar, writing the result to the member's
`imageData` the same way the upload flow does.

Note on the trailing request ("default image-taken date extracted from the
uploaded image"): this **already exists** — gallery uploads read EXIF
`DateTimeOriginal` via `_extract_exif_date_taken` in
`backend/app/services/storage.py` and default the photo date to it (shipped in
#792/#793). No work needed there.

## Approach

Reuse the existing crop → `imageData` → autosave pipeline. The **only** new
input is the image source: instead of a `FileReader` data URL, we resolve a
linked gallery image's protected media URL to a same-origin blob URL and feed
that into the existing `ImageCropDialog`. `EditMode` stays the single owner of
the avatar state and crop dialog; `MemberPhotos` only surfaces the action and
calls back up.

Keep it to `MemberPhotos` only (not the gallery `ImageSheet`) — `ImageSheet` is
tree-wide and has no single target member, so "set as profile picture" has no
natural home there.

## Changes

### 1. `frontend/src/hooks/useMediaUrl.ts`
- Export the existing `fetchMediaObjectUrl(src)` helper (currently module-private)
  so `EditMode` can resolve a gallery media URL to an authenticated, same-origin
  blob URL. It already fetches with the auth/public-tree headers and returns a
  fresh object URL the caller owns. No behavior change.

### 2. `frontend/src/components/shared/member-sheet/EditMode.tsx`
- Add an async handler `handleSelectGalleryImage(image: GalleryImage)`:
  - `const url = await fetchMediaObjectUrl(image.imageData)` inside try/catch;
    on failure `toast.error(t("toast-error-file"))`.
  - `setSelectedImage(url)` — this reuses the existing `selectedImage` state,
    which already drives `ImageCropDialog` (`isOpen={!!selectedImage}`). A blob:
    URL is same-origin, so `getCroppedImg`'s `canvas.toDataURL` is not tainted.
- Revoke the blob URL when done so it doesn't leak: in `onConfirm` and in the
  dialog's `onCancel`, if `selectedImage?.startsWith("blob:")` call
  `URL.revokeObjectURL(selectedImage)` before clearing it. (File-upload flow uses
  `data:` URLs, which need no revoke — the guard skips them.)
- Pass the handler down: `<MemberPhotos member={member}
  onSelectProfilePicture={handleSelectGalleryImage} />`.
- The cropped result flows through the **unchanged** `onConfirm` →
  `handleChange("imageData", …)` → autosave → `updateMemberPartial`, so avatar
  display (AC #2) and quota/size validation via the existing 413/400 handling in
  `persistSnapshot` (AC #3) come for free.

### 3. `frontend/src/components/shared/member-sheet/MemberPhotos.tsx`
- Add prop `onSelectProfilePicture: (image: GalleryImage) => void`.
- On each linked thumbnail, wrap the `AuthenticatedImage` in a `relative group`
  container and add a hover overlay button (mirrors the avatar hover affordance
  in `EditMode`, using the `UserRoundCog` or `ImageUp` lucide icon) that calls
  `onSelectProfilePicture(image)`. Give it `aria-label={t("photos-set-as-profile")}`
  and a tooltip.

### 4. i18n — `frontend/src/i18n/locales/{en,de}.json` (`sheet.edit-mode`)
- Add `"photos-set-as-profile"`:
  - en: `"Use as profile picture"`
  - de: `"Als Profilbild verwenden"`
- Reuse the existing `toast-error-file` key for a resolve failure.

### 5. `CHANGELOG.md`
- Under `## [Unreleased]` → `Added`: "Set a member's profile picture from an
  already-linked gallery photo (with crop), without re-uploading."

## Not doing
- No backend changes: avatar continues to store its own 300px cropped JPEG data
  URL (matches current behavior; simplest, and what AC implies).
- No new feature flag: this extends core member editing / the existing `gallery`
  feature; it's not a separable domain. (`MemberPhotos` already only renders when
  `gallery` is enabled.)
- No changes to the gallery `ImageSheet`.

## Verification
- `cd frontend && npm run build && npx vitest run && npm run check-i18n`
- Manual (dev stack): open a member with a linked gallery photo → Records tab →
  hover a photo → click "Use as profile picture" → crop dialog opens → crop →
  confirm → avatar at the top of the sheet updates and autosaves; reopen to
  confirm it persisted. Also verify the existing file-upload avatar flow still
  works and that an oversized crop still surfaces the quota toast.

content.text:
## Review — PR #794: `feat(member-sheet): set profile picture from a linked gallery photo`

**Overview:** Lets a user pick one of a member's already-linked gallery photos and use it (cropped) as the profile picture, instead of only via file upload. It reuses the existing `ImageCropDialog` + `imageData` autosave path by fetching the gallery image as an authenticated blob URL and feeding it into the same `selectedImage` state `EditMode` already uses for uploads. No backend/schema changes — 7 files, +102/−13.

### Code quality & correctness
- Clean reuse of existing infrastructure: `fetchMediaObjectUrl` (newly exported, previously private), `ImageCropDialog`, `handleChange("imageData", …)` → autosave → existing 413/400 quota/type error handling. No duplicated crop or persistence logic.
- `releaseSelectedImage` correctly discriminates `blob:` (gallery-sourced, needs revoke) vs `data:` (file-upload-sourced, no-op) so the existing upload flow's behavior is unchanged.
- `type="button"` is correctly set on the new overlay button — required since `MemberPhotos` renders inside `<form id="edit-member-form">` in `EditMode`; missing it would submit the form.
- Prop change (`onSelectProfilePicture` made required, not optional) is a good choice — forces callers to wire it rather than silently no-op.

### Minor / non-blocking observations
- **Blob URL not revoked on unmount**: if the member sheet closes (or the member is switched) while a gallery-photo fetch is in flight or the crop dialog is open, the created blob URL is never revoked (`onConfirm`/`onCancelCrop` are the only release points). Low impact — one object URL, released by the browser on navigation/reload — but could be tightened with a cleanup effect if this pattern gets reused elsewhere.
- **No cancellation on rapid re-trigger**: `handleSelectGalleryImage` doesn't guard against overlapping calls (e.g., clicking two thumbnails back-to-back before the first fetch resolves). In practice the crop dialog is modal so the underlying grid isn't clickable once open, making this effectively unreachable — not worth added complexity.
- Error toast on fetch failure reuses `toast-error-file` ("Failed to read file") rather than a dedicated string — acceptable reuse, message still fits.

### Test coverage
- New test verifies the hover action fires `onSelectProfilePicture` with the correct `GalleryImage` for a linked photo — good, focused unit coverage matching the existing test's style.
- The `EditMode`-level wiring (`fetchMediaObjectUrl` → `setSelectedImage` → confirm → `handleChange`) isn't covered by an automated test, but `EditMode.test.tsx` already fully mocks `MemberPhotos`, consistent with the pre-existing test boundary — not a regression in this PR's scope.
- Full suite (663 tests), build, and `check-i18n` all pass per the PR description.

### i18n / conventions
- New key `photos-set-as-profile` added to both `en.json` and `de.json`, used consistently for both `aria-label` and tooltip text — follows the existing pattern in `ImageSheet.tsx`.
- CHANGELOG entry present under `## [Unreleased]` → `Added`, referencing #776.

### Security
- Reuses `fetchMediaObjectUrl`, which already carries the Bearer/public-tree token and respects existing tree-access authorization — no new attack surface.

**Verdict:** No blocking issues. Solid, appropriately scoped change that reuses existing plumbing rather than introducing new patterns.

The PR is up: **https://github.com/maxi-smidt/family-tree/pull/794**
